contract: Road user x is passing road user y on y's right at the observation: the side-by-side phase of an overtaking. It holds where their headings are aligned (rel.same_direction, with aligned_cosine as the relation's tolerance), their bodies overlap along x's heading (rel.longitudinal_overlap positive), y lies on x's left (the lateral component of rel.bearing of y from x, in x's frame), and x's speed exceeds y's (kin.speed, m/s) by more than speed_margin, the speed resolution below which the two count as keeping pace. Not denoted: the approach from behind or the return ahead of y, where either body is on the road, a lane change, contact, or the clearance between the bodies.

params.name: aligned_cosine
params.meaning: the cosine of the largest angle between the two headings that counts as aligned

params.name: speed_margin
params.meaning: the speed resolution of a speed difference: an excess at or below it counts as keeping pace

elements.span: their headings are aligned (rel.same_direction, with aligned_cosine as the relation's tolerance)
elements.justification: rel.same_direction: 'headings aligned: the cosine of the angle between the headings is above its tolerance'.

elements.span: their bodies overlap along x's heading (rel.longitudinal_overlap positive)
elements.justification: rel.longitudinal_overlap: 'the bodies overlap along the subject's heading (side by side)'; it is 'neither a contact nor a distance between the bodies', and neither is read from it.

elements.span: y lies on x's left (the lateral component of rel.bearing of y from x, in x's frame)
elements.justification: rel.bearing: 'direction of b from a in a's frame (for "on the right of", ...)'.

elements.span: x's speed exceeds y's (kin.speed, m/s) by more than speed_margin
elements.justification: kin.speed: 'magnitude of velocity', m/s, read for both road users.

scenarios.name: holds
scenarios.narrative: x drives on the shoulder alongside a slower y in the rightmost lane, y on x's left, the bodies side by side, x gaining.

scenarios.name: fails
scenarios.narrative: x follows y in the same lane, its body wholly behind y's.

scenarios.name: blind
scenarios.narrative: x and y are side by side and x is faster; the source declares rel.bearing absent.
